verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at support.pagerduty.com. Support pages are also served as .md files, the developer docs are published as raw markdown on GitHub, and a machine-readable OpenAPI schema repo is public, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms.txt or llms-full.txt for the developer/API portal, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
